Row.Text: On its way to meet the Sultan, Dr Rizal is taken aback when traversing the bazaar and the immense variety of products. To observe it all would take a long time, a time that could be spent talking with the Sultan.
Take the time to impregnate yourself with the sounds and smells of the location.
Ask the Sultan about the logistics of the market.
The Great Book of a Dynasty

A chronicler was asked by the Sultan to write a great book to record his legacy and how well they ruled the land. The chronicler doesn't have to lie, they can see how they turned the desert into a magnificient trading hub. But what to write? What to focus on?
It will be a detailled record of all production, inventory and trade in all the kingdom.
It will be an encyclopedia on the efficiency of different fiscal and administrative policies.
The Sultan has accumulated much knowledge and wisdom over the years. He is now ready to put it down in ink. He will first write a treatise...
The Conquest of the Holy Sites
With the Conquest of the Holy City, our prestige is only growing. The other nations have to choice but to admire our splendor.
Yemen will be one of the Greats.

The Date Palm Plantations are flourishing in the kingdom. We produce more and more and yet, we keep selling all of them, for both our own consuption and exports. It might be the most profitable crop of the kingdom.
Think about making them more profitable first.

The empire grows larger and larger and we need to delegate our authority to govern the larger cities more efficiently. However, the royals officials disagree on how to maintain such buzzling settlements.
Listen to the wali and focus on administration.
+0.5 [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS] Happiness for each Urban population in all Cities.
Listen to the mushidd and focus on tax collection.
+0.5 [icon:YIELD_GOLD] Gold for each Urban population in {1_Capital}.

The Zarug was designed at a time where we lacked wood to create big ships but the recent explotations of Hardwood, this isn't a problem anymore. Some shipbuilders suggest to complety redesign the zarug to have more capacity while others, not wanting to change their line of production, are advocating for no changes at all.

Huge boats from far away have arrived in the port. They claimed to be envoys from a place called the Ming Empire. They bring with them perfumes, pottery and scented wood. That kind of wealth and riches can't be faked. They asked of us to send another batches of treasures, in order to formalize diplomatic relations.
More opportunities to trade cannot hurt. We will send them corals and wild animals.
Send a Trade Route to Ming.
You recieve a letter that your gifts have arrived and the emperor is fascinated by the giraffe you sent. You are now considered as a great trading partner.
We will not be subjugated by them.
{1_reward} and +1 [icon:TRADE_ROUTE][/B] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_TRADE_ROUTE_TOOLTIP]Trade Route[/TIP] Limit with all other Leaders.
